title: Payoff Details
description: Details on number and size of payments to pay off balance

minimum_payment_months.description: The number of months it would take to pay off the balance in full by only paying the minimum payment. "NA" will signal negative or zero amortization

minimum_payment_total.description: The sum of all interest and principal paid, in cents, when only paying minimum monthly payment. "NA" will signal negative or zero amortization

payoff_period_length_months.description: Number of months to full pay off

payoff_period_monthly_payment_amount.description: The amount needed to be paid, in cents, each month in order to pay off current balance in the payoff period

payoff_period_payment_total.description: The sum of all interest and principal paid, in cents, when paying off in the payoff period
